angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 497,426 km at 119.02 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.4016 +/- 0.0168 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 119.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.715 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract): 497,426 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.756 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4687 +/- 65 K from Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Zingales et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1803 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1803.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.608, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1803 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.014 dex, from Zingales et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1803 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.65365, from Zingales et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1803 (pscomppars): age 1.4 Gyr, from Zingales et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1803 (pscomppars): rotation period 13.659 d, from Zingales et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1803 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1 km/s, from Zingales et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.273Z/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.715 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.378. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
